summary: Blackburn Lookout Tower in Claiborne Parish, torn down per the Wikipedia list; the list says it shows on 1998 aerial imagery. No build, staffing or site record found.

facts.status_note: Torn down, according to the Wikipedia list; no source describes the site today.

events.note: Wikipedia list says the tower appears on aerial imagery from 1998
Wikipedia list marks the tower torn down; the list gives no date

the list is for Claiborne County
1915 funds for fire protection work allowing the hiring of lookout watchmen or patrolmen
evidence.quote: In 1915 funds were directed for fire protection work allowing the hiring of lookout watchmen or patrolmen.

evidence.supports: first steel fire tower built near Bogalusa in 1922
evidence.quote: In 1922 the first steel fire tower was built near Bogalusa on Great Southern Lumber Company land.

evidence.supports: second tower built near Urania in 1923
evidence.quote: In 1923 the second tower was built near Urania
By 1943 thirty-nine fire towers had been built and by 1950 the number had increased to fifty-six.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Wikipedia list gives parish, nearest town, coordinates, status and one aerial-imagery note; Central US Lookouts and TopoZone agree on the parish and map name. No build, design, height, staffing, fire or access information in any source read. The record's county and coordinates match the sources. No photos found. Records for this tower are short by necessity, so the story is brief.
